name: Spaces Forgotten
author: Terraform
description: Hold to the ceiling between the saws at 33.2% to skip the ball portal as the wave. Continue holding until 36.0% where you need to release for a tiny bit, touch the invisible mini portal and then hold back to the ceiling. Fall to the floor at 37.8% between the structures, go over the structure on the floor at 38%, touch the reverse gravity portal and then hold to the floor. Fall up at 39.5% between the saw and block. Do a tiny click at 31.7% and then don’t click to fall to the ceiling between the block and saw. Hold down at 47.7% and release at 48.3% to get the 4x speed portal without touching the ship portal and be able to fall back to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling until 12% where you can move to the floor. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
